pages.text: A 2 x 2 x 3 multiblock that pours a new $(item)Shatter Totem$(). It melts a long bill of metals into its tanks, fills a mould of eight pieces standing in its hollow middle, and lets the totem set.$(br2)Stuck on a build? Empty your hand and $(l)sneak + right-click$() the controller for the step-by-step Assembly Guide.

pages.name: Totem Forge
pages.text: Bottom: the Totem Forge front left, the Metal Intake behind it, a Forge Hearth on the right of each. Middle: empty. Top: Melt Tanks left, Pour Head front right, Forge Cap behind it.

The tanks must hold the whole metal bill before the forge pours. Its screen shows a tube for each metal; by default 128 Tetrium, 32 Magnatite, 8 Charged Magnatite, 12 Illyrium, 32 Allthemodium, 16 Vibranium, 8 Unobtainium and 2 Netherite Ingots.$(br2)Ingots go into the Metal Intake or the screen's slot and melt one at a time, burning lava from the Forge Hearths. An RF Upgrade speeds it up. Molten Tetrium, Magnatite and Illyrium can be piped straight into the intake.
pages.title: The metal

pages.text: The $(l:machines/totem_mould)Totem Mould$() goes into the hollow one piece at a time, in order: the Base, two Feet, the Torso, two Arms, the Head, and the Totem Core last. Right-click the forge with each piece.$(br2)$(l)Sneak + right-click$() with an empty hand, or TAKE PIECE OUT on the screen, takes the last piece back out, until the metal is poured.
pages.title: The mould

pages.text: With the mould complete and the tanks full, press $(l)POUR$().$(br2)If you own no Shatter Totem, the pour is free and the totem sets in 5 days. If you own any, you pay 4 Illyrium Shatter Coins for each one first (or their worth in any other Shatter Coins, with change), and it sets in 15 days.$(br2)You can have one totem pouring or setting at a time, on any server.
pages.title: Pouring

pages.text: The totem sets on real time, even while you are away, and you are told when it is ready. Right-click the forge with an empty hand to take it out: a $(item)Forged Shatter Totem$(), tier I, yours.$(br2)Anyone else must steal it the same way: they stay by the forge for two and a half minutes while you are warned. Break the forge before the totem has set and the pour is lost.
